---
title: "3. The Model Building Process"
---

## Overview

This module provides participants with an overview of the model building process, from defining the problem and selecting assumptions to developing, testing, and refining a model. The session focuses on understanding the key stages involved in building credible and policy-relevant models, while emphasising the importance of transparency, stakeholder engagement, and iterative development.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="default"}
## Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, participants should be able to:

-   Identify the key steps in building a model from concept to application

-   Understand how assumptions, data, and structure combine within a model

-   Discuss the key principles of modelling for policy
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="default"}
## Key Concepts

-   Problem definition and scope

-   Conceptual model design

-   Data inputs and parameterisation

-   Assumptions and simplifications

-   Validation and calibration

-   Iterative model development

-   Principles of modelling for policy
:::

## Delivery Plan

This module consists of one content session and a case study or guest speaker (suggested 2-3 hours)

+--------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------+----------------------------+
| Introduction to the Model Building Process | Overview of the modelling pipeline                      | 30 min      | Presentation               |
|                                            |                                                         |             |                            |
|                                            | Moving from a policy question to a model                |             |                            |
+--------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------+----------------------------+
| Principles of Modelling for Policy         | Presentation of key principles                          | 30 min      | Presentation               |
|                                            |                                                         |             |                            |
|                                            | Importance and applications of principles               |             |                            |
+--------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------+----------------------------+
| Guest Speaker\*                            | Real world example of policy-focused modelling          | 45 min      | Group discussion (plenary) |
|                                            |                                                         |             |                            |
|                                            | Lessons and challenges throughout the modelling process |             |                            |
+--------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------+----------------------------+
| Reflection and Wrap-Up                     | Linking the principles and process to practice          | 10 min      | Presentation               |
|                                            |                                                         |             |                            |
|                                            | Roadmap of curriculum expanding on pipeline elements    |             |                            |
+--------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------+----------------------------+

*\*This is a good opportunity to invite a guest speaker. However, this session would also work as a case study run by the facilitation team.*

### Facilitator Guidance

-   Avoid overly technical detail unless appropriate for the audience

-   Focus on understanding process rather than mathematical formulation

-   Link principles to real-world implications and examples

-   Highlight how the curriculum will expand different elements of the modelling pipeline
